kaikki_vikisozluk.e: فَذْلَكَ • (faḏlaka) Iq (non-past يُفَذْلِكُ (yufaḏliku), verbal noun فَذْلَكَة (faḏlaka))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Formed by naḥt (نَحْت, coinage by blending) from the phrase فَذٰلِكَ (fa-ḏālika, “so that is …”) as used in totting up a reckoning, فَذٰلِكَ كَذَا وَكَذَا (“this, then, is so-and-so much”). Compare the like-formed بَسْمَلَ (basmala), حَمْدَلَ (ḥamdala) and حَوْقَلَ (ḥawqala).
g: to cast up, to reckon up, to sum up, to total (an account)
to summarize, to recapitulate; to give the gist or upshot of (a discourse)
